The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, with corner- and edge-sharing observed between Al- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
